title: 第4621章 混沌海左巡使第4620章 葬天墟
slug: 剑道狂神第4623章一枚令牌
lines: 三天后，冥花那边传回了第一条线索。
“混沌海西南边缘有一片被称为‘葬天墟’的星域，据说那里隐居着一位道神境巅峰的老怪物。
那人从不露面，也从不与外界往来，但附近的星域都被他布下了禁制，靠近就会被弹开。”
“葬天墟？”
唐天眉头一挑，“有坐标吗？”
“有，但只能到外围。
那人布下的禁制覆盖了整个星域，连我们的探测阵盘都没法深入。”
冥花传来了一幅星图，图中标注的方位十分清晰。
“我去一趟葬天墟，看看能不能找到那个老怪物。”
唐天收起星图，叫上了云皓。
“我也去！”
胖子小风立马举起战锤。
“你就别去了，留下来帮我守着裂缝那道封印。
云皓跟我去就行，人多了反而会引起对方的警觉。”
唐天拍了拍他肩膀。
胖子小风虽然不情愿，但也没多说什么：“行，我守裂缝。”
半日后，唐天和云皓登上了一艘星空级潜行舰，朝着葬天墟的方向疾驰而去。
葬天墟外围的景象，比想象中更荒凉。
星辰稀疏零落，有的已经碎裂大半，漂浮在虚空中缓慢旋转。
空气中残留着淡淡的法则波动，像是有人刻意布置过的防御层。
“前面那道禁制，应该就是那个老怪物布下的。”
云皓盯着探测阵盘，神色凝重。
唐天站起身走到舷窗前，他能感觉到那道禁制并不算特别强大，却带着一种非常独特的波动，像是专门用来隔绝神识探查的。
“停在这里，我出去试试。”
唐天走出战舰，独自朝着那道禁制飞去。
靠近的瞬间，一股柔和的推力从前方传来，像是有人轻轻推了他一把。
唐天稳住身形，没有硬闯，而是开口说了一句话。
“晚辈剑门唐天，有要事求见前辈。
若前辈愿意一见，晚辈以剑门信誉担保，绝不会打扰前辈清修。”
声音在虚空中扩散开去，被那道禁制微微阻挡了一下，但还是穿透了过去。
然后他等了大约十息，那道禁制的波动忽然出现了一丝微妙的变化，像是被人从内部调整了参数。
前方原本闭合的屏障缓缓裂开一道缝隙，刚好容一人通过。
“进来吧。”
content_en:
Three days later, the first clue came back from Minghua.
“There is a star field called the ‘Burial Tianxu’ on the southwest edge of the Sea of Chaos. It is said that an old monster at the peak of the Taoist Realm lives in seclusion there.
That person never showed up and never interacted with the outside world, but the nearby star field was restricted by him, and he would be bounced away if he got close. "
"Burial Tianxu?"
Tang Tian raised his eyebrows, "Do you have the coordinates?"
“Yes, but only to the outside.
The restriction set by that person covers the entire star field, and even our detection array cannot penetrate deep. "
Minghua sent a star map, and the directions marked in the map were very clear.
"I'll go to Burying Heaven Market to see if I can find that old monster."
Tang Tian put away the star map and called Yun Hao.
"I'll go too!"
Fatty Xiaofeng immediately raised his war hammer.
"Don't go, stay and help me guard the seal of the crack.
Yun Hao can just go with me. If there are too many people, it will arouse the other party's vigilance. "
Tang Tian patted his shoulder.
Although Fatty Xiaofeng was reluctant, he didn't say much: "Okay, I'll guard the crack."
…
Half a day later, Tang Tian and Yun Hao boarded a Starry Sky-class stealth ship and sped towards the Burial Sky Ruins.
The scene outside Burying Heaven Market was more desolate than imagined.
The stars are sparse and scattered, and some have been mostly broken into pieces, floating and rotating slowly in the void.
There is a faint law fluctuation left in the air, like a defensive layer deliberately arranged by someone.
"The restriction in front was probably placed by that old monster."
Yun Hao stared at the detection array disk with a solemn expression.
Tang Tian stood up and walked to the porthole. He could feel that the restriction was not particularly powerful, but it carried a very unique wave, as if it was specially designed to block the detection of spiritual consciousness.
"Stop here, I'll go out and try."
Tang Tian walked out of the battleship and flew towards the restriction alone.
The moment he got closer, a soft push came from the front, as if someone had pushed him gently.
Tang Tian stabilized his body and did not rush in. Instead, he said something.
"Jianmen Tang Tian, my junior, has something important to ask to see my senior.
If the senior is willing to meet, the junior will guarantee the reputation of Jianmen and will never disturb the senior's cultivation. "
The sound spread in the void and was slightly blocked by the restriction, but it still penetrated through.
Then he waited for about ten breaths, and the restricted fluctuation suddenly showed a subtle change, as if someone had adjusted the parameters from the inside.
The originally closed barrier in front slowly opened a gap, just enough for one person to pass through.
"Come in."
